454.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
A cheerful girl who loves to fantasize. She adores beautiful boys combining together, and often gets a nosebleed daydreaming about pairing up $$シュレード$$ and $$カイエン$$. Her catchphrase is 'I'm gonna rot away!'
She also enjoys secretly photographing people as a hobby, and has a formidable business sense for turning a profit by selling the photos she takes.
Her $$エレメント$$ ability is 'Corrosion Force,' which lets her rot and decay any material.
In a mock battle, she teamed up with $$カイエン$$ and $$モロイ$$ to corrode $$ＥＶＯＬ$$'s legs and leave it unable to move.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 盗撮 is taking photos secretly, not 'candid photography'

455.DSCR:
Commander of $$ネオディーヴァ$$ and chairwoman of $$聖天使学園$$.
A mysterious, beautiful girl who is always together with $$不動$$.
She traveled the world in search of $$アクエリオン$$, but upon hearing news of its revival she returned and resumed her post as commander.
Though she looks like nothing more than a girl, her IQ is said to exceed 300, and her age is unknown. She speaks to the $$エレメント$$ cadets with an adult's manner of speech.
Yet she also has a girlish side, being extremely fond of donuts, which are always kept on her desk in the command room.
She possesses the $$エレメント$$ ability 'Teleport,' and at the final battle, after the death of $$シュレード$$, whom she had cared deeply about, she boarded a $$ベクターマシン$$ herself. Together with $$カイエン$$ and the others, she boarded $$アクエリオンゲパルト$$ and fought $$ミカゲ$$.

proofread.reason: addition: 年齢も不詳 says the age is unknown; 'true' is not in the Japanese

456.DSCR:
A pilot of $$アルテア$$.
Belligerent by nature, he pilots the $$ミスラ・グニス$$ and fights with the same raw ferocity as his temperament. He also has a keen sense of smell, and everything about his behavior is wild.
He repeatedly went after $$ミコノ$$, calling her 'my own damn woman,' and clashed fiercely with $$アマタ$$ each time.
His true identity is another $$アマタ$$: when their mother $$アリシア$$ departed for $$アルテア$$, his body and heart were split between the $$アマタ$$ who only watched her go and the $$カグラ$$ who chased after her. After crossing over to $$アルテア$$ he lost his memories and was taken in by $$ミカゲ$$, who showered him with twisted love, until he came to trust in nothing but his own power.
Through the fighting, guided by $$ミカゲ$$, he awakened the $$エレメント$$ ability 'Reversal Force,' which reverses any phenomenon or force. This same ability is also the reason his words come out reversed from what he means to say, under a certain rule.
Like $$アマタ$$, $$カグラ$$ too is a reincarnation of $$アポロ$$, and for that reason he found himself strongly drawn to $$ミコノ$$, the reincarnation of $$シルヴィア$$.
At the final battle, he acknowledged that $$アマタ$$ loved $$ミコノ$$ regardless of memories from a past life, and lent his support to $$アマタ$$ as he challenged $$ミカゲ$$, the source of it all.

457.DSCR:
A boy called $$アルテア$$'s last child.
Unlike $$カグラ$$, he is a cerebral type skilled at electronic warfare, and pilots the $$ラディウス・グニス$$.
He runs endless simulations of past combat data and enters battle prepared for every contingency. His thoroughly calculated tactics drove $$ネオディーヴァ$$ into a corner more than once.
However, his pride is also a weakness, leaving him poorly equipped to respond to the unexpected.
He has no interest in flesh-and-blood women, and instead is in love with a female virtual doll.
Ordered by $$イズモ$$ to search for $$アクエリオン$$ and the $$レア・イグラー$$, he enrolled at $$聖天使学園$$ under a false identity.
At first he could not adjust to life among women, but through talking with $$ユノハ$$, who was just as shy as he was, he gradually opened up to her. When $$カグラ$$ attacked $$ネオディーヴァ$$, he took the opportunity to steal a $$ベクターマシン$$ along with $$ユノハ$$ and try to return to $$アルテア$$. But $$ユノハ$$'s persuasion made him honest with his own feelings, and he boarded $$アクエリオン$$ as one of the $$エレメント$$s and fought $$カグラ$$.
The other members came to accept him as a new comrade, but immediately afterward his life was taken by a thought-form of $$ミカゲ$$.

459.DSCR:
Supreme Commander of $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
He was initially disguised as a school custodian and the like, but returned when $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$ revived.
He always carries himself as though he sees through everything, giving $$クレア$$ and the $$エレメント$$ cadets cryptic, Zen-koan-like advice that leaves them baffled. But it always carries a deep purpose, and understanding its meaning can lead one out of even the direst situation.
When he uses analogies, he tends to reach for donuts.
He guided $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$, the reincarnations of the $$エレメント$$s who fought 12,000 years ago, and once the battle was settled, he took $$ミカゲ$$'s soul, left with nowhere to go as pure resentment, into his own heart and sealed it away.

461.DSCR:
Deputy Commander of $$ネオディーヴァ$$ and a teacher at $$聖天使学園$$.
He is in charge of educating the male students, including combat training.
Belligerent by nature, he prioritizes the annihilation of the enemy above all else, and brings a harsh, military-style Spartan discipline to his classes and training.
The forearm of his attachment-type prosthetic arm can be fitted with interchangeable attachments such as a stun gun or a fork.
Nine years ago, he was an $$エレメント$$ cadet who piloted $$アクエリオン$$ himself. But when his romantic feelings for his girlfriend $$ナナオン$$ reached a peak, $$アクエリオン$$ ran out of control, and he lost both his girlfriend and his own arms. From then on, male-female combination in $$アクエリオン$$ was forbidden.
He and his colleague $$スオミ$$ have clashed a number of times over differences in teaching philosophy, but at the final battle he was visibly shaken by her when she agreed with Chairwoman $$クレア$$'s words, 'If it comes to it, become the Adam and Eve of the next era.'

462.DSCR:
Deputy Commander of $$ネオディーヴァ$$ and a teacher at $$聖天使学園$$.
Before the fall of the Berlin Wall, she taught on the girls' side.
Her personality is straitlaced to the point of rigidity, so she does not much approve of male-female combination and tends to look down on men somewhat.
Since she took up her post later than $$ドナール$$ or the Commander, she knew almost nothing of the truth behind $$アクエリオン$$.
As fellow deputy commanders, she and $$ドナール$$ spend a great deal of time together, but their opposing ways of thinking often put them at odds.
But her feelings changed as the fighting continued, and she gradually began to see $$ドナール$$ differently.
Before the final battle, when $$クレア$$, about to sortie, told her that if it came to it she should become the Adam and Eve of a new era together with $$ドナール$$, she agreed.

463.DSCR:
A priest of $$アルテア$$.
He can use a wide range of psychic abilities.
Deeply mysterious, his capricious words and actions sometimes lend aid and sometimes cause obstruction, leaving even Supreme Commander $$イズモ$$ at his mercy.
He found $$カグラ$$ as a child in the slums and raised him.
He had been asleep for many years, but awoke in response to $$アクエリオン$$'s revival and began to act toward his own private ends.
His true identity is the dark portion of $$頭翅#pilot$$, born when $$頭翅#pilot$$ learned that $$アポロ$$ was not, in fact, the reincarnation of his beloved $$アポロニアス#pilot$$. $$頭翅#pilot$$ himself accepted this truth and became a living sacrifice to save the world, but the part of his heart that could not accept it ran wild and took on a form of its own.
He sought to revive the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$ and use its power to destroy both $$ヴェーガ$$ and $$アルテア$$, in order to create a new world.
At the final battle, he seized the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$ and absorbed the whole of $$アルテア$$'s energy. He then conjured a black sun to try to scorch the Earth dry, transformed the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$ into the $$エンシェントＡＱ$$, and stood in $$アマタ$$'s way. But he was defeated before $$アマタ$$, who sought to save $$ミコノ$$ beyond the bounds of fate, and $$ネオディーヴァ$$, who lent $$アマタ$$ their support.
Afterward, he was taken in by $$不動ＺＥＮ$$ and fell asleep within his heart.

464.DSCR:
Supreme Commander of $$アルテア$$.
A hero who has developed $$アルテア$$ using the $$アイアンシー$$ technology developed by his mother, $$オリザ・カムロギ$$. He commands the effort to restore his home planet, which stands on the brink of ruin.
He is $$アマタ$$'s biological father. While visiting $$ヴェーガ$$ (that is, Earth) himself in search of the $$レア・イグラー$$, he met $$アリシア$$, and $$アマタ$$ was born to them.
He had intended to leave $$アリシア$$ and $$アマタ$$ on Earth, but $$ミカゲ$$ caught wind of their existence, and $$アリシア$$ was taken to $$アルテア$$.
On the battlefield he piloted $$アルテア$$'s strongest unit, the $$アフラ・グニス$$. His skill was overwhelming, driving $$ネオディーヴァ$$'s $$アクエリオン$$ into desperate straits, and even overpowering $$カグラ$$ piloting the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$.
But when $$ミカゲ$$'s scheme led to an attack on $$アリシア$$, he was shaken, and defeated when his enemies struck at that opening.
At the brink of death he reconciled with his son $$アマタ$$, and together with $$アリシア$$'s spirit, entrusted $$アマタ$$ with hope.

465.DSCR:
A boy belonging to the $$人類銀河同盟$$. 16 years old.
His rank is second lieutenant, and he boards $$チェインバー・Ｋ６８２１#robot$$.
During combat with the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ he was swallowed by a spacetime distortion and drifted to Earth, where he lay sunk in the sea in artificial hibernation for about half a year until he was salvaged by the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet and awakened.
Because he knows nothing but fighting, he is poor at expressing emotion and wears a blank expression.
Since the language of Earth differs from that of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, he cannot converse there either, and his conversations with the residents of the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet are conducted through $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s translation function.
Though bewildered by the differences in lifestyle, ethics, and values, with the help of $$エイミー$$ and the others he learns about life in the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet.

After defeating $$ストライカー#robot$$ with the cooperation of the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet and the suicide charge of $$チェインバー#robot$$, he came to live in the fleet as an adventurer.

466.DSCR:
The pilot support and enlightenment interface system installed in the $$マシンキャリバー$$, a mass-production unit of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ military, that $$レド$$ boards.
An autonomous AI whose mission is to raise the pilot into a better soldier through dialogue, it is also capable of controlling the unit on its own.
To support the soldier who is its occupant, it also has functions such as gathering and assessing information about its surroundings and simultaneous translation of conversations between different languages. However, it basically follows the judgment of its pilot, $$レド$$.
To $$レド$$ it is an irreplaceable presence: a partner, a confidant, and a comrade who aims together with him to return to the $$人類銀河同盟$$.
$$ピニオン$$ calls it by the nickname 'Tin Can.'

467.DSCR:
A girl who works as a $$メッセンジャー$$ in $$ガルガンティア$$. 15 years old.
Curious and action-oriented, she never loses her cheerful, energetic smile.
After an unexpected encounter with $$レド$$, who had awakened from artificial hibernation, she took a keen interest in him and became the bridge between him and the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet.
She is skilled at handling kites and gliders, and uses them for delivery work and scouting missions.
She cherishes her sickly younger brother, $$ベベル$$.

468.DSCR:
A girl who works as a $$メッセンジャー$$ like $$エイミー$$. 15 years old.
She is also good friends with $$メルティ$$, and the three always go around together. Easygoing by nature, she also shows a side that is sharp about money.
Incidentally, she has a glamorous figure, in contrast to the childish $$メルティ$$.

469.DSCR:
A girl who works as a $$メッセンジャー$$ like $$エイミー$$ and $$サーヤ$$. 14 years old.
Younger than the other two messengers, and looking young for her age, she likes to act more grown-up than she is. She loves good-looking guys and is sensitive to romance talk, but apparently has no romantic experience.
She calls $$レド$$ 'Hottie' and butts into his conversations at every opportunity.

470.DSCR:
A girl who runs a salvage business in the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet, hauling up materials of the old civilization from the sea. 18 years old.
Skilled at operating the work machine $$ユンボロ$$, she is a strict big-sister type about work, yet is deeply trusted by her companions.
She often argues with $$ピニオン$$, a flippant, ambitious sort.
She recovered $$チェインバー#robot$$ from the seabed and handed it over to $$ピニオン$$.

471.DSCR:
A woman who assists $$フェアロック$$, the leader of the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet. 22 years old.
Serious, calm, and rational-minded, with a strong sense of responsibility. But because of that, she is also earnest to a fault and inflexible, and not a few people keep their distance from her.

472.DSCR:
A young man who runs a machine repair and maintenance business in $$ガルガンティア$$. 20 years old.
A flippant sort, but his maintenance knowledge and skill are reliable, and he has a fair amount of popularity.
He dreams of striking it rich by digging up treasure sleeping on the seabed.
He also does salvage work on the side, but since he cannot dive into water, he is trying to recruit $$レド$$, who has come to live in the $$ガルガンティア$$ Fleet.
He often quarrels with $$ベローズ$$, but they are not on bad terms.
